headline: Nvidia Board Does Not Intend to Reinstate Huang as CEO
deck: The company also created a board committee for national-security policy, export-control compliance and global trade risk.
body: Nvidia’s board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, new board chair Harvey Jones said at the company’s quarterly earnings call, after the board unanimously accepted Huang’s resignation [E1]. This is a public board decision beyond the paper’s 17 November report that a person familiar with the board’s thinking told The Associated Press it was not currently considering Huang’s return [E4].

Nvidia also established a standing National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee for board-level oversight of its national-security policies, export-control compliance and global trade risk management [E2]. Nvidia said its National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team will report to the committee and to interim chief executive Colette Kress on day-to-day operations [E3].

evidence_box.fragment: Starting Nvidia’s quarterly earnings call on Tuesday, new board chair Harvey Jones said that when former CEO Jensen Huang resigned, “the Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO.”
